title: Judgment on Israel's Enemies

questions.question: The oracle of the word of the Lord is against the land of...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:1 (ESV): "The oracle of the word of the Lord is against the land of Hadrach and Damascus is its resting place."

questions.question: Tyre has built herself a rampart and heaped up silver like dust, and fine gold like the...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:3 (ESV): "and heaped up silver like dust, and fine gold like the mud of the streets."

questions.question: But behold, the Lord will strip Tyre of her possessions and strike down her power on the sea, and she shall be devoured by...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:4 (ESV): "and she shall be devoured by fire."

questions.question: Ashkelon shall see it, and be afraid; Gaza too, and shall writhe in anguish; Ekron also, because its hopes are...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:5 (ESV): "Ekron also, because its hopes are confounded."

questions.question: A mixed people shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:6 (ESV): "A mixed people shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of Philistia."

questions.question: "Then I will encamp at my house as a... so that no one shall march to and fro;"
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:8 (ESV): "Then I will encamp at my house as a guard, so that no one shall march to and fro;"

questions.question: "Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion! Shout aloud, O daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your king is coming to you; righteous and having salvation is he, humble and mounted on a..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:9 (ESV): "humble and mounted on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey."

questions.question: "I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the war horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow shall be cut off, and he shall speak peace to the..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:10 (ESV): "and he shall speak peace to the nations;"

questions.question: His rule shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:10 (ESV): "his rule shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth."

questions.question: As for you also, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will set your prisoners free from the...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:11 (ESV): "I will set your prisoners free from the waterless pit."

questions.question: Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope; today I declare that I will restore to you...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:12 (ESV): "today I declare that I will restore to you double."

questions.question: "For I have bent Judah as my bow; I have made Ephraim its..."
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:13 (ESV): "For I have bent Judah as my bow; I have made Ephraim its arrow."

questions.question: Then the Lord will appear over them, and his arrow will go forth like...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:14 (ESV): "and his arrow will go forth like lightning;"

questions.question: On that day the Lord their God will save them, as the flock of his people; for like the... of a crown they shall shine on his land.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:16 (ESV): "for like the jewels of a crown they shall shine on his land."

questions.question: For how great is his goodness, and how great his beauty! Grain shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the...
questions.explanation: Zechariah 9:17 (ESV): "Grain shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the young women."

key_verse_text: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion! Shout aloud, O daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your king is coming to you; righteous and having salvation is he, humble and mounted on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
